visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man with short dark hair, wearing a grey sleeveless tank top and black athletic shorts, stands in a modern gym. He joins his palms in a meditative gesture before dropping to the floor to perform pushups. The background shows racks of dumbbells and a black plyo box. Above him, a split-screen displays digital game footage of Lee Sin performing similar martial arts stances on a grassy terrain under natural daylight. (2) The man rolls a large black medicine ball across the gym floor and performs a forward leaping jump. He wears white sneakers and socks that contrast with the dark rubber flooring. The gym background includes a red plyo soft box and various weight machines. Above, the game footage shows the character Gnar transforming and hopping across a stone and grass battlefield. (3) The man holds a circular black weight plate and performs a heavy ground-slam motion, lunging forward with intensity. The lighting is bright and even, reflecting off the metallic surfaces of the gym equipment. Above him, the character Malphite is shown in a rocky environment performing a massive ground-stomp ability that creates a shockwave on the screen. (4) The man stands near a weight bench and performs a rapid spinning motion while holding a silver dumbbell in both hands, his face showing physical exertion. The gym background is filled with racks of weights and black mats. In the top screen, the character Garen is shown spinning his large sword in a continuous circle within a grassy game map. (5) The man sits on a weight bench and vigorously waves two heavy black battle ropes, creating rhythmic oscillating waves. He maintains a focused gaze forward. The gym walls are wood-paneled with black metal accents. Above, the character Sylas swings thick glowing chains in a similar fashion against an opponent in a rocky game arena. (6) The man performs a smooth forward roll on the gym floor and ends in a low, crouching tactical pose with one hand touching the ground. He looks sharply to his side. The background features a tall blue and red plyo box. Above, the character Ekko is shown dashing and rolling through a fantasy environment with green magical trails. (7) The man stands within a yellow-framed power rack and performs explosive overhead presses using a black resistance band. He wears a serious expression as he extends his arms fully. The gym lighting is warm and bright. Above, the character Alistar performs a powerful stomp and roar animation, surrounded by blue electrical effects on the game screen. (8) The man uses a large green plastic barrel as a weight, slamming it onto the floor and then lifting it to his mouth to mimic a drinking gesture. He moves with high energy around the weight benches. Above, the character Gragas is seen throwing barrels and drinking from a large jug in a stylized fantasy forest area.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an epic, high-energy rock song featuring a driving electronic beat and gritty male vocals singing 'Warriors.' A sharp, metallic sound effect with high spectral brightness triggers, mimicking a martial arts strike as the man performs pushups. (2) The rhythmic drum beat continues at a fast tempo. A distinct low-frequency thud sound occurs as the medicine ball hits the floor, followed by a whoosh sound effect synchronized with the man's jump and the game character's transformation. (3) A massive, bass-heavy impact sound effect occurs, mimicking a seismic ground slam. This sound has a wide spectral bandwidth and long decay, overlapping with the persistent high-energy BGM. The singer's voice remains energetic and soaring in the background. (4) A rapid, fluttering metallic sound effect, resembling a spinning blade, is introduced. It has a high-frequency shimmering texture that pans slightly as the man spins with the dumbbell. The BGM maintains a steady, driving intensity. (5) The audio shifts to include the rhythmic, percussive sounds of heavy ropes hitting the floor, which are tightly synchronized with the musical beat. A clashing chain sound effect is layered on top, featuring bright metallic transients. (6) A digital, synthesized whoosh sound effect occurs, characterized by a rising pitch sweep, matching the man's forward roll and the character's dash. The music remains at a high arousal level with intense synthesizer pads. (7) A loud, booming stomp sound effect with a powerful low-end punch is heard, accompanied by a synthesized roar. These sounds are layered over the continuous rock anthem, which begins to swell in intensity towards a crescendo. (8) Multiple impact sound effects occur in rapid succession as the green barrel hits the floor. A liquid pouring and gulping sound effect is then heard, followed by a comedic 'bottoms up' grunt, all synchronized with the visual actions.
